body:
Here are my must-listen podcasts during the quarantine (I love podcasts and I listen to twice as many as I list here (off and on), so these are my current favorites):

 The Confessional with Nadia Bolz-Weber

 The Ron Burgundy Podcast (I know … I know …)

 Mega (I know … I know …)

 Gaslit Nation

 Homebrewed Christianity

 Turning to the Mystics with James Findlay

 Another Name for Every Thing

 Reverend Hunter

 EcoCiv

 John Dear’s Peace Podcast

 Freedom Road Podcast with Lisa Sharon Harper

  

 If you want to be freaked out, I’d add

 It Could Happen Here
